article.story: CINCINNATI -- — Myles Colvin made 7 of 12 from 3-point range and scored 31 points to help Cincinnati beat Green Bay 81-64 on Thursday night. Colvin, who had two 30-point games for Wake Forest last season, was 10-of-17 shooting and finished with seven rebounds and two blocks for Cincinnati (2-0). Amani Lyles made 7 of 10 from the field and finished with 14 points. MJ Collins and Eric Mahaffey each scored 11. Orlando Lovejoy led Green Bay (1-1) with 16 points on 7-of-10 shooting. Isaiah Sutherland and Clarence Payia each scored 12. Mahaffey made a layup that gave Cincinnati the lead for good with 6:56 left in the first half and followed with a dunk before Colvin converted a four-point play that capped a 10-2 spurt and made it 29-22 about 90 seconds later. Mahaffey, who transferred from Akron, hit a 3-pointer and Colvin added two free throws to make it a 10-point game before the Bearcats took a 40-32 lead into halftime. Sutherland made a 3 that trimmed the deficit to four points early in the second half but the Phoenix got no closer. Cincinnati scored nine of the next 11 points to make it 50-39 with 15:29 to play and MJ Collins capped a 12-0 spurt gave the Bearcats a 21-point lead, their biggest of the game, with 8:11 remaining. Up next Green Bay: Plays Sunday at St. Thomas. Cincinnati: Hosts Minnesota on Monday. ------ Sign up for Top 25 poll alerts here, visit the Top 25 here and see AP’s full men’s basketball coverage here
